attributes.morphology: convex lens-like, staggered at a certain angle

evidence.quote: some convex lens-like precipitates (indicated by the white arrow) stagger at a certain angle. Based on the SAED pattern shown in Fig. 2(d), the orientation relationship between the precipitate and matrix identified is [001] b' // [0001] a, (100) b'// (2-1-10) a
the microstructure of the base metal (BM) consists of some equiaxed grains with a size of about 50 µm

the b' precipitates in the aging treated HAZ distributed unevenly presumably due to the segregation of Gd, Y atoms in the as-welded HAZ before the aging treatment process

attributes.location: fracture surface, junction of grain boundaries

evidence.quote: some cavities can also be observed in Fig. 5(d), which are caused by the void growth originating at the junction of grain boundaries
measured by a Vickers hardness tester (Zwick Zh l, Zwick) with a load of 200 g and holding time of 15 s
the curve of the HAZ in the as-welded joint appears a lowest hardness value (78 HV), which locate at the boundary of the FZ.
the microhardness of the weakest part of the HAZ in the aging-treated joints increases sharply to 110 HV and keeps a level close to the hardness of the BM.

the ultimate tensile strengths of aging-treated joints are declining slightly by about 38 MPa from room temperature to 250 °C

This is benefit from the precipitation of high-density b' in the HAZ

mechanisms.name: crack initiation at brittle eutectic phase

evidence.quote: Because the Mg24(Gd,Y)5 phase located at the grain boundaries is brittle and hard, the cracks can originate easily at the interior of Mg24(Gd,Y)5 phase by the local stress concentration and the specimens exhibit transgranular fracture when the tensile test temperature locates from room temperature to 250 °C.

mechanisms.name: deformation of ultrafine grains and unstable eutectic phase

evidence.quote: The deformation of the ultrafine grains and unstable Mg24(Gd,Y)5 phase in the FZ of aging-treated joints at 300 °C deteriorated the high temperature tensile properties.
